As British American Tobacco Plc (BTI) Stock Declined, Wintergreen Advisers Has Lowered Its Position; Fedex (FDX) Position Maintained by Ifc Holdings Incorporated
May 21, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
David Winters decreased its stake in British American Tobacco Plc (BTI) by 74.79% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wintergreen Advisers Llc sold 736,847 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.55% with the market. The hedge fund run by David Winters held 248,333 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.64 million, down from 985,180 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wintergreen Advisers Llc who had been investing in British American Tobacco Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $104.58B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.21% or $0.62 during the last trading session, reaching $50.44. About 1.20 million shares traded. British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSEMKT:BTI) has declined 15.61% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.16% the S&P500.
Ifc Holdings Incorporated increased its stake in Fedex Corp (FDX) by 5.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ifc Holdings Incorporated bought 1,314 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.15% with the market. The institutional investor held 23,411 shares of the air freight and delivery services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.82 million, up from 22,097 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ifc Holdings Incorporated who had been investing in Fedex Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $67.99 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.00% or $4.9933 during the last trading session, reaching $254.4433. About 643,715 shares traded. FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) has risen 25.45% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 13.90% the S&P500.
Among 7 analysts covering British Amrcn Tobacco ( NYSEMKT:BTI ), 5 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 71% are positive. British Amrcn Tobacco had 9 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. On Thursday, December 10 the stock rating was downgraded by Goldman Sachs to “Sell”. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Friday, July 29 by Societe Generale. The stock has “Buy” rating by Investec on Thursday, September 8. The firm earned “Market Perform” rating on Tuesday, August 25 by Cowen & Co. The stock has “Buy” rating by Societe Generale on Friday, October 28. The stock of British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSE:BTI) earned “Buy” rating by Bank of America on Tuesday, August 4. As per Wednesday, November 2, the company rating was upgraded by Morgan Stanley. On Thursday, May 25 the stock rating was initiated by Piper Jaffray with “Overweight”. Investec upgraded British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSE:BTI) on Friday, August 4 to “Buy” rating.
Among 37 analysts covering FedEx ( NYSE:FDX ), 26 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 70% are positive. FedEx had 117 analyst reports since August 14, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Cowen & Co maintained FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) rating on Friday, December 16. Cowen & Co has “Outperform” rating and $240 target. The stock has “Buy” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets on Tuesday, October 10. On Friday, July 7 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Buy”. Stephens maintained FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) on Wednesday, June 21 with “Buy” rating. Stifel Nicolaus maintained it with “Hold” rating and $289.0 target in Thursday, January 18 report. JP Morgan maintained FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) rating on Thursday, October 12. JP Morgan has “Overweight” rating and $264 target. The stock of FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) has “Outperform” rating given on Monday, December 14 by Credit Suisse. The stock of FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) earned “Buy” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Thursday, November 30. The stock of FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) earned “Buy” rating by Standpoint Research on Wednesday, January 20. The stock of FedEx Corporation (NYSE:FDX) has “Buy” rating given on Wednesday, June 21 by UBS.
Ifc Holdings Incorporated, which manages about $3.29 billion and $1.45 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in First Tr Inter Dur Pfd & In (FPF) by 80,487 shares to 37,785 shares, valued at $920,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ishares Tr (IWF) by 3,033 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 96,474 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
